visits.clinical_notes: Diagnosis/Complaint: Dyslipidaemia (LDL 172 mg/dL); Primary Hypothyroidism — stable; Vitamin D deficiency — corrected. Advice: dietary changes, exercise, report muscle pain/tenderness while on Atorvastatin; continue Levothyroxine regularly. Investigations: Fasting Lipid Profile, SGPT, TSH, Serum 25-OH Vitamin D in 3 months. Next review: Review in 3 months with reports.
